implementation_role: comparison-layer implementation only; no R1, C2, or entry object is rederived
solution_concept: counterfactual comparison of complete entry-augmented perfect Bayesian equilibrium assessments under two fixed institutional rules
native_payoff_date: entry date; imported C1 payoffs are already in Round-1 units and receive no additional discount

validated_common_domain.existence: both frozen entry correspondences are nonempty for every primitive-admissible point in this domain

counterfactual_comparison_protocol.fixed_rules: unanimity and majority are fixed counterfactual institutions; there is no endogenous rule-choice or rule-choice signaling stage
counterfactual_comparison_protocol.unanimity_assessment_set: A_U(P) is the exact full assessment set exported by the approved entry-unanimity interface
counterfactual_comparison_protocol.majority_assessment_set: A_M(P) is the exact full assessment set exported by the approved entry-majority interface
counterfactual_comparison_protocol.comparison_index_set: A_U(P) x A_M(P), the full Cartesian product of complete assessments
counterfactual_comparison_protocol.no_coupling_primitive: the game supplies no selection, common random device, rank matching, shared off-path belief, or correlation restriction across the two counterfactual rules
prohibited_couplings: matching assessments by proposer payoff or scalar gross value
matching lower to lower or upper to upper endpoints
using one rule's belief, continuation selection, identity permutation, or outcome kernel inside the other rule
averaging or optimizing over assessment pairs
choosing a favorable pair and reporting it as a selection-free ranking
counterfactual_comparison_protocol.retained_payload: each comparison element retains alpha_U and alpha_M whole, including every type-by-identity payoff, H payoff, strategy, belief, continuation selection, cost ledger, and aligned outcome distribution

pairwise_operator.gross_values: G_R=G_R(alpha_R,mu) for R in {U,M}, imported literally from the corresponding complete entry element
pairwise_operator.weak_realized_collective_net: W_R(alpha_R,mu,chi)=e_R*(G_R-chi), hence W_R=0 when the rule does not form
pairwise_operator.formation_pattern: both if (e_U,e_M)=(1,1), U_only if (1,0), M_only if (0,1), and neither if (0,0)
pairwise_operator.outcome_retention: the comparison record contains both complete rule-specific realized entry outcomes; it never replaces them by the formation label or payoff deltas

exact_comparison_correspondence.necessity: without a cross-rule selection primitive, every admissible whole assessment under one counterfactual rule can be paired with every admissible whole assessment under the other
exact_comparison_correspondence.sufficiency: each coordinate is independently an approved entry PBE assessment for its fixed rule, and the comparison operator changes neither coordinate
exact_comparison_correspondence.selection_status: exact and set-valued on the Cartesian product; no institutional ranking is selected

pairwise_formation_sets.strict_sets: F_U(alpha_U) is a strict subset of F_M(alpha_M) iff G_U<G_M, and conversely with U and M exchanged
pairwise_formation_sets.U_only_cost_region: G_M<chi<=G_U; this region is nonempty iff G_U>G_M
pairwise_formation_sets.M_only_cost_region: G_U<chi<=G_M; this region is nonempty iff G_M>G_U
pairwise_formation_sets.equality_discipline: the upper boundary belongs to the forming rule in each exclusive region

endpoint_and_status_logic.attainment: a_R_minus and a_R_plus record lower- and upper-endpoint attainment; no general compactness or attainment is presumed
endpoint_and_status_logic.possible_form: PF_R(chi) iff chi<u_R, or chi=u_R and a_R_plus=1
endpoint_and_status_logic.product_reason: the four existence statements are exact because the admissible comparison index is the full Cartesian product
endpoint_and_status_logic.upper_boundary_warning: at chi=u_R, PF_R is false when the supremum is unattained; a numerical supremum alone cannot create a forming assessment
endpoint_and_status_logic.lower_boundary_note: at chi=l_R, PN_R is false irrespective of lower-endpoint attainment, because no value lies strictly below its infimum

cost_set_projections.possible_U_in_M: K_U_exists subseteq K_M_exists iff u_U<u_M, or u_U=u_M and [a_U_plus=0 or a_M_plus=1]
cost_set_projections.possible_M_in_U: K_M_exists subseteq K_U_exists iff u_M<u_U, or u_M=u_U and [a_M_plus=0 or a_U_plus=1]
cost_set_projections.possible_set_equality: K_U_exists=K_M_exists iff u_U=u_M and a_U_plus=a_M_plus; strict inclusion is inclusion plus failure of this equality condition
cost_set_projections.guaranteed_U_in_M: K_U_forall subseteq K_M_forall iff l_U<=l_M; strict iff l_U<l_M and equal iff l_U=l_M
cost_set_projections.guaranteed_M_in_U: K_M_forall subseteq K_U_forall iff l_M<=l_U; strict iff l_M<l_U and equal iff l_M=l_U
cost_set_projections.distinction: possible-cost and guaranteed-cost projections compare unions or intersections within each rule; neither is the universal cross-assessment pair condition below

selection_free_global_nesting.U_in_M_for_all_pairs: F_U(alpha_U) subseteq F_M(alpha_M) for every cross-pair iff u_U<=l_M
selection_free_global_nesting.M_in_U_for_all_pairs: F_M(alpha_M) subseteq F_U(alpha_U) for every cross-pair iff u_M<=l_U
selection_free_global_nesting.strict_U_in_M_for_all_pairs: F_U(alpha_U) is a strict subset of F_M(alpha_M) for every cross-pair iff u_U<l_M, or u_U=l_M and not[a_U_plus=1 and a_M_minus=1]
selection_free_global_nesting.strict_M_in_U_for_all_pairs: F_M(alpha_M) is a strict subset of F_U(alpha_U) for every cross-pair iff u_M<l_U, or u_M=l_U and not[a_M_plus=1 and a_U_minus=1]
selection_free_global_nesting.proof_basis: all cross-pair inequalities G_U<=G_M are equivalent to sup S_U<=inf S_M, and analogously with the rules reversed
selection_free_global_nesting.global_equality: all cross-pair formation sets are equal iff both value sets are the same singleton, equivalently l_U=u_U=l_M=u_M
selection_free_global_nesting.numeric_status: the frozen interfaces do not generally identify u_U or l_M, so no general numeric U-in-M conclusion is made; they also do not generally identify u_M or l_U at N=3
selection_free_global_nesting.no_same_rank_shortcut: checking selected, same-rank, endpoint-matched, or proposer-payoff-matched pairs is neither necessary nor sufficient for a Cartesian-product global nesting claim

hegemon_outside_option_floor.claim: for every complete frozen C1 assessment alpha_R, every rule R, and every type theta, C1_R,H^alpha_R(theta)>=o_theta
hegemon_outside_option_floor.proof: at every H ballot information set, action no gives type theta the immediate irreversible opt-out payoff o_theta for every simultaneous weak-vote realization; PBE sequential rationality makes H's equilibrium behavioral action weakly better than that available action, and proposal-mixture plus uniform-recognition integration preserves the inequality
hegemon_outside_option_floor.simultaneous_vote_discipline: the proof does not condition H on an unobserved weak-vote vector and does not reduce relevance to the quota
hegemon_outside_option_floor.entry_implication: H_R(theta)>=o_theta whether the rule forms or not
hegemon_outside_option_floor.floor_attainment_if_possible_no: if PN_R(chi) holds, some complete entry element does not form and attains H_R(theta)=o_theta simultaneously for both types
hegemon_outside_option_floor.all_no_implication: if all assessments under rule R choose no, every entry element gives the exact outside-option vector to H

neither.hegemon: H_U(theta)=H_M(theta)=o_theta for both types and Delta_H(mu)=0

U_only.hegemon: Delta_H(theta)=C1_U,H(theta)-o_theta>=0 for each type, hence Delta_H(mu)>=0

M_only.hegemon: Delta_H(theta)=o_theta-C1_M,H(theta)<=0 for each type, hence Delta_H(mu)<=0

both.hegemon: Delta_H(theta)=C1_U,H(theta)-C1_M,H(theta); its sign is indeterminate without the retained pair values

conditional_pairwise_rankings.interpretation: these are conditional identities and bounds for each complete pair, not an assessment selection or unconditional institutional dominance theorem

pairwise_weak_curve_and_H_rents.weak_curve_order: G_U<=G_M iff W_U(chi)<=W_M(chi) for every chi>=0; equality of the curves for every cost iff G_U=G_M
pairwise_weak_curve_and_H_rents.strictness_warning: U_only or M_only yields only a weak H ranking because the forming rule's rent may equal zero

selection_free_payoff_bounds.no_cross_rule_H_sign: outside the neither, U_only, and M_only conditional cases, the outside-option floor alone gives no sign for Delta_H
selection_free_payoff_bounds.outcome_warning: equal payoffs or equal formation status do not identify equal payments, inclusion, opt-out histories, or outcome distributions

special_endpoint_consequences.zero_cost: at chi=0 every assessment under both rules forms, so every comparison pair has pattern both
special_endpoint_consequences.cost_above_envelope: at chi>1/m every assessment under both rules does not form, so every pair has pattern neither and both H types receive their outside options
special_endpoint_consequences.Nge4_endpoints: for every N>=4, entry-U proves l_U=0 attained and entry-M proves u_M=1/m attained
special_endpoint_consequences.Nge4_possible_cost_nesting: K_M_exists=[0,1/m], so K_U_exists subseteq K_M_exists; equality versus strict inclusion depends on u_U and its upper-attainment flag
special_endpoint_consequences.Nge4_guaranteed_cost_nesting: K_U_forall={0} subseteq K_M_forall=[0,l_M]; equality versus strict inclusion depends on whether l_M=0 or l_M>0
special_endpoint_consequences.Nge4_M_only_existence: for every N>=4 and 0<chi<=1/m, pairing an attained U assessment with G_U=0 and an attained M assessment with G_M=1/m yields an M_only comparison element
special_endpoint_consequences.Nge4_extreme_pair_H_equality: the frozen M value-one assessment gives H its type-specific outside payoff; paired with U nonformation, the guaranteed M_only pair has Delta_H(theta)=0 for both types, so no strict H advantage follows
special_endpoint_consequences.Nge4_extreme_pair_weak_delta: on that pair Delta_W=-(1/m-chi), strictly negative for 0<chi<1/m and equal to zero at chi=1/m despite the M_only status
special_endpoint_consequences.chi_equal_one_over_m: the same construction remains M_only at chi=1/m because majority forms at equality and unanimity with G_U=0 does not form
special_endpoint_consequences.logical_scope: the N>=4 endpoints prove possible-cost U-in-M nesting, guaranteed-cost U-in-M nesting, existence of an M_only pair, and failure of universal cross-assessment M-in-U nesting; they do not prove universal cross-assessment U-in-M nesting, that every pair is M_only, or that either rule is selected
special_endpoint_consequences.N3_status: the special zero-U and one-over-m-M endpoint attainments are not imported at N=3; only the exact pairwise and endpoint-conditional statements apply

rejected_shortcuts: rederiving or repairing R1, C2, or entry
coupling counterfactual assessments without a primitive
comparing proposer-payoff projections instead of collective gross entry values
using endpoint bounds as attained assessments
claiming universal nesting from the N>=4 M_only existence construction
claiming an unconditional H ranking when both rules form
introducing endogenous rule choice or interpreting fixed-rule differences as signaling

verification.scope: exact dependency bytes; Cartesian-product algebra; exhaustive finite value sets; attained and unattained endpoint logic; randomized complete asymmetric assessment pairs with type-specific H coordinates and retained outcome labels; N=3 and N>=4 boundaries; false-nesting and proposer-projection negative tests; dependency mutations; and 27 protected hashes

claim_status.possible_and_guaranteed_cost_set_nesting: proved with endpoint-attainment, strictness, and equality conditions
claim_status.selection_free_global_nesting_iff: proved as an endpoint characterization; general numeric ordering pending and not claimed
claim_status.hegemon_outside_option_floor: proved from the frozen H ballot best-response inequalities
claim_status.Nge4_extreme_M_only_pair_has_no_strict_H: proved from the frozen M value-one assessment
claim_status.endogenous_rule_choice_or_signaling: outside the game and rejected as an interpretation

review.consumer_rule: no survival-matrix or manuscript consumer may treat this candidate as frozen before independent acceptance of its exact hash

invalidation: any byte change to the exact entry batch, either approved entry interface, the common N>=3 domain, equality formation, complete-assessment preservation, collective entry primitive, or fixed-rule counterfactual protocol invalidates this candidate and every descendant
artifact_hash_policy: SHA-256 is computed externally over exact UTF-8 bytes; no self-referential digest is embedded
